slashCommands.name: makii
slashCommands.description: Context-aware prompt builder — takes simple task descriptions and produces detailed, project-optimized prompts for DeepSeek, Claude, and other reasoning models.

slashCommands.name: ceo
slashCommands.description: Chief Executive Orchestrator — analyzes tasks, selects optimal subagents from 155+ specialists, delegates work, and synthesizes results. Use: /ceo <task>

slashCommands.name: build
slashCommands.description: Implement tasks incrementally — build, test, verify, commit. Add "auto" to run the whole plan in one approved pass.

slashCommands.name: code-simplify
slashCommands.description: Simplify code for clarity and maintainability — reduce complexity without changing behavior

slashCommands.name: plan
slashCommands.description: Break work into small verifiable tasks with acceptance criteria and dependency ordering

slashCommands.name: review
slashCommands.description: Conduct a five-axis code review — correctness, readability, architecture, security, performance

slashCommands.name: ship
slashCommands.description: Run the pre-launch checklist via parallel fan-out to specialist personas, then synthesize a go/no-go decision

slashCommands.name: spec
slashCommands.description: Start spec-driven development — write a structured specification before writing code

slashCommands.name: test
slashCommands.description: Run TDD workflow — write failing tests, implement, verify. For bugs, use the Prove-It pattern.

slashCommands.name: webperf
slashCommands.description: Run a web performance audit via the web-performance-auditor persona
